studies.title: Angel Falls
studies.caption: A narrow stream falls from the edge of Auyán-tepui and breaks into mist above the forest.
studies.prompt: Low view from forested valley toward Angel Falls pouring as a slender vertical ribbon off the immense flat-topped sheer wall of Auyan-tepui, dispersing into mist before wooded lower slopes. Massive tabletop plateau, no pointed volcanic cone, no broad Niagara curtain.
